title: On-Time Shipping Guarantee — Class Schedule for Factory Production Orders
content:
The on-time shipping guarantee of Factory Production Orders is carried by some build classes and not others. The schedule below gives each class's guarantee figures.

| Build class | Carries the guarantee | Grace period (business days) | Credit per unit per full week late (USD) | Most credit per order (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Custom Size Build | Yes | 5 | 25.00 | 250.00 |
| Custom Color Build | Yes | 5 | 25.00 | 250.00 |
| Specialty Glass Build | Yes | 7 | 30.00 | 300.00 |
| Specialty Shape Build | No | 7 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Impact-Rated Build | No | 10 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Architectural Wood Build | Yes | 10 | 50.00 | 500.00 |

Where a class carries no guarantee, its credit and cap read 0.00.

## Terms common to every class

- **Grace period** — the business days after the guarantee benchmark date before a shipment counts as late.
- **Excluded delay causes** — customer hold, late acknowledgment, customer specification remake, and weather and freight. A delay with one of these causes moves the guarantee benchmark instead of earning credit.
- **Week basis** — full calendar weeks: only complete 7-day periods are counted for the credit.
- **Remade units** — units that are remade earn no guarantee credit for their own remake lead time.
- **Application to the contract** — an earned credit is applied to the contract within 5 business days after the ship date.
- **Where an earned credit goes** — contract balance, then refund: the credit is applied to the contract the order builds, and any part exceeding the amount owed is refunded under that contract's refund rules.
- **Escalation count** — after 3 delay notices on one order, the next delay is escalated to the production manager instead of being handled by support.

## Points of reading

- A Specialty Shape Build or Impact-Rated Build order carries no guarantee, whatever its grace figure reads.
- The cap is per order: two orders of one customer each have their own cap.
